name: – Marcos Ros Sempere – § 3 – Am 1
title: REPORT on a new strategy for media literacy and digital learning
part_text: 3. stresses that media literacy and digital learning must not be exploited within the framework of the ‘Democracy Shield’, which risks promoting a uniform and ideologically biased view of information; recalls that democracy is based on free debate and not on institutional determinations of what constitutes legitimate information; expresses concern that such measures may lead to the marginalisation of opinions, including those critical of EU policies;
